20th People's Majlis

People's Majlis

People's Majlis Committee Minutes

4th meeting of the Environment and Climate Change Committee

15 June 2026

Meeting venue: People's Majlis building (Committee Room 6)

Start time: 11:40

{Presiding: Committee Chair; Member for South Maafannu constituency, Abdulla Rifau}

Chair speaking:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Welcome to the 4th meeting of the People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee, the 4th meeting of this session. The meeting is being held in Committee Room 6. Today's date is 15 June 2026. The time is 11:40. On the agenda for today's meeting is a discussion on the committee's work. In this regard, there are currently 5 matters before this committee on which decisions need to be made. The first matter is the case submitted sharing concerns about the services of FENAKA Corporation in Fuvahmulah. In connection with that matter, we held a meeting in this committee with the management of FENAKA Corporation, and on that day they told this committee that they would rectify matters in this regard. So, since this matter has not been concluded, it is on this agenda. Therefore, the committee needs to decide how to conclude this matter. So, I open the floor to committee members.

Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, speaking:
This is Musthafa. In this matter, since FENAKA met with this committee, discussed it and said they would resolve it, I think we can close this matter by checking its current status and informing the party [who submitted it]. So, I actually propose that.

Chair speaking:
Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency, Abdulla Shazeem.

Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency, Abdulla Shazeem, speaking:
Thank you, honourable Chair. I second the proposal made by the honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency, Musthafa Ibrahim.

Chair speaking:
Yes! We have received a proposal on how to proceed with the letter received regarding concerns about the services of FENAKA Corporation in Fuvahmulah. I call for a vote of those in favour of the proposal as moved by the honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa, and seconded by Abdulla Shazeem of Central Hulhumalé constituency. (Voting) Yes! This proposal has been passed unanimously. Next is the second matter: arranging a meeting, as the Audit Office has requested to meet this committee to share the work being carried out in connection with the International Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions. It has been some time since we received this letter, last year. We have already met with them once. Now they have requested to meet again with the current updates. So, in that regard, how about leaving two weeks and scheduling this meeting for July? So, we will schedule it for one of the 3 days 6, 7, 8 July, at a time convenient for the Audit Office as well. So, I would conclude this matter by sending a letter from this side giving the Audit Office that choice. Next is the letter sent by Project Thimaaveshi and several other associations sharing concerns about the damage caused by reducing the protected area of mangroves and wetlands for the project planned to widen the Addu City Hithadhoo Link Road. Yes! Along with that same matter, there is a letter sent by the Member for North Galolhu constituency, Mohamed Ibrahim, as the last matter. So, these two are matters that go together. So, I think I would propose that in this matter we obtain information about it from the relevant ministries. After that we can decide how to proceed with this matter. What do you think? If there are any views, I open it to members.

Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, speaking:

In this matter now being discussed, which has come regarding the land reclamation work from the Addu [unclear] area, I actually think that the information should be obtained from the Ministry of Construction and the Ministry of Environment, stating that this matter has been received, and that a written request be sent for that information to be provided to this side, and once that document is received, we then proceed with this matter. So, I wanted to say that.

Chair speaking:
Member for Mulaku constituency, Ibrahim Naufal.

Member for Mulaku constituency, Ibrahim Naufal, speaking:
I second the proposal made by the honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim.

Chair speaking:
Yes! We have now received a proposal from Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim of West Maafannu constituency, and the honourable Member for Mulaku constituency, Ibrahim Naufal, has seconded that proposal. So, I ask those in favour of this proposal to vote. (Voting) Yes! The vote we just took has passed unanimously. Next is a letter sent by various parties expressing concerns about running a housing project in the Villimalé Funavalu area, with their views. In this matter, the Minister has also spoken about it on the floor of the People's Majlis. However, since this matter has come to the committee, I think the committee should formally proceed with this matter, and at the same time I open the committee for the honourable members of the committee to express their views as they see fit. Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa.

Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, speaking:

I don't think the committee should proceed further with this matter. The reason is that the government has now changed its policy and the government has also announced it. Also, the Minister came here and answered, and has said that it has now been decided not to cut these trees. So, I want to say that I don't think this committee should proceed any further with this matter, considering it resolved. Thank you. So, I actually propose that we give that information as it is to the person who sent this matter to this committee and close this matter.

Chair speaking:
Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency, Abdulla Shazeem.

Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency, Abdulla Shazeem, speaking:
Thank you, honourable Chair. I second the proposal made by the honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim.

Chair speaking:
Regarding the letters sent by various parties expressing concerns about running a housing project in the Villimalé Funavalu area, the honourable Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency, Abdulla Shazeem, has seconded the proposal just made by the honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa. So, I ask those in favour of this proposal to vote. (Voting) Thank you. The vote just taken has passed unanimously. So, decisions have now been made on the matters before us in today's committee. I want to say that, God willing, we will schedule a committee meeting as soon as possible, as soon as we receive information that allows us to proceed with these matters. With this, today's committee meeting is concluded. Thank you very much.
